lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਮਖ ਨਿਮਖ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਹੁ ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਤੁਮਰੇ ਧਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: nimakh nimakh tum hee pratipaalahu ham baarik tumare dhaare ||1||
lines.translation: Each and every moment, You cherish and nurture me; I am Your child, and I rely upon You alone. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਏਕ ਕਵਨ ਗੁਨ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: jihavaa ek kavan gun kaheeai ||
lines.translation: I have only one tongue - which of Your Glorious Virtues can I describe?

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੇਸੁਮਾਰ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੇਰੋ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਕਿਨ ਹੀ ਲਹੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: besumaar bea(n)t suaamee tero a(n)t na kin hee laheeai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Unlimited, infinite Lord and Master - no one knows Your limits. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਟਿ ਪਰਾਧ ਹਮਾਰੇ ਖੰਡਹੁ ਅਨਿਕ ਬਿਧੀ ਸਮਝਾਵਹੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: kot paraadh hamaare kha(n)dahu anik bidhee samajhaavahu ||
lines.translation: You destroy millions of my sins, and teach me in so many ways.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਅਲਪ ਮਤਿ ਥੋਰੀ ਤੁਮ ਆਪਨ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਰਖਾਵਹੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: ham agiaan alap mat thoree tum aapan birad rakhaavahu ||2||
lines.translation: I am so ignorant - I understand nothing at all. Please honor Your innate nature, and save me! ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਮਰੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਆਸਾ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਸਜਨ ਸੁਹੇਲੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tumaree saran tumaaree aasaa tum hee sajan suhele ||
lines.translation: I seek Your Sanctuary - You are my only hope. You are my companion, and my best friend.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਖਹੁ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਘਰ ਕੇ ਗੋਲੇ ॥੩॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: raakhahu raakhanahaar daiaalaa naanak ghar ke gole ||3||12||
lines.translation: Save me, O Merciful Saviour Lord; Nanak is the slave of Your home. ||3||12||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਜਾ ਵਰਤ ਤਿਲਕ ਇਸਨਾਨਾ ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨ ਬਹੁ ਦੈਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: poojaa varat tilak isanaanaa pu(n)n daan bahu dain ||
lines.translation: Worship, fasting, ceremonial marks on one's forehead, cleansing baths, generous donations to charities and self-mortification

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਹੂੰ ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ਸੰਜਮ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਮੀਠੇ ਬੈਨ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kahoo(n) na bheejai sa(n)jam suaamee bolahi meethe bain ||1||
lines.translation: - the Lord Master is not pleased with any of these rituals, no matter how sweetly one may speak. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਤ ਮਨ ਚੈਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: prabh jee ko naam japat man chain ||
lines.translation: Chanting the Name of God, the mind is soothed and pacified.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰ ਖੋਜਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਲੈਨ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: bahu prakaar khojahi sabh taa kau bikham na jaaee lain ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Everyone searches for Him in different ways, but the search is so difficult, and He cannot be found. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾਪ ਤਾਪ ਭ੍ਰਮਨ ਬਸੁਧਾ ਕਰਿ ਉਰਧ ਤਾਪ ਲੈ ਗੈਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaap taap bhraman basudhaa kar uradh taap lai gain ||
lines.translation: Chanting, deep meditation and penance, wandering over the face of the earth, the performance of austerities with the arms stretched up to the sky

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਨਹ ਪਤੀਆਨੋ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਜੋਗ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਜੈਨ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: ih bidh nah pateeaano thaakur jog jugat kar jain ||2||
lines.translation: - the Lord is not pleased by any of these means, though one may follow the path of Yogis and Jains. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰਮੋਲਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਤਿਨਿ ਪਾਇਓ ਜਿਸੁ ਕਿਰਪੈਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)mrit naam niramolak har jas tin paaio jis kirapain ||
lines.translation: The Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, and the Praises of the Lord are priceless; he alone obtains them, whom the Lord blesses with His Mercy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭੇਟੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖਿ ਜਨ ਰੈਨ ॥੩॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: saadhasa(n)g ra(n)g prabh bhete naanak sukh jan rain ||3||13||
lines.translation: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, Nanak lives in the Love of God; his life-night passes in peace. ||3||13||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੰਧਨ ਤੇ ਛੁਟਕਾਵੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਨਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ba(n)dhan te chhutakaavai prabhoo milaavai har har naam sunaavai ||
lines.translation: Is there anyone who can release me from my bondage, unite me with God, recite the Name of the Lord, Har, Har,

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਕਤਹੂ ਧਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: asathir kare nihachal ihu manooaa bahur na katahoo dhaavai ||1||
lines.translation: and make this mind steady and stable, so that it no longer wanders around? ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੈ ਕੋਊ ਐਸੋ ਹਮਰਾ ਮੀਤੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: hai kooo aiso hamaraa meet ||
lines.translation: Do I have any such friend?

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਗਲ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਜੀਉ ਹੀਉ ਦੇਉ ਅਰਪਉ ਅਪਨੋ ਚੀਤੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sagal samagree jeeu heeu deu arapau apano cheet ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I would give him all my property, my soul and my heart; I would devote my consciousness to him. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਰ ਧਨ ਪਰ ਤਨ ਪਰ ਕੀ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਇਨ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: par dhan par tan par kee ni(n)daa in siu preet na laagai ||
lines.translation: Others' wealth, others' bodies, and the slander of others - do not attach your love to them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਤਹ ਸੰਗੁ ਸੰਤ ਸੰਭਾਖਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨਿ ਮਨੁ ਜਾਗੈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)tah sa(n)g sa(n)t sa(n)bhaakhan har keeratan man jaagai ||2||
lines.translation: Associate with the Saints, speak with the Saints, and keep your mind awake to the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਪੁਰਖ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਬ ਸੂਖ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: gun nidhaan daiaal purakh prabh sarab sookh daiaalaa ||
lines.translation: God is the treasure of virtue, kind and compassionate, the source of all comfort.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਗੈ ਦਾਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਿਉ ਮਾਤਾ ਬਾਲ ਗੁਪਾਲਾ ॥੩॥੧੪॥
lines.transliteration: maagai daan naam tero naanak jiu maataa baal gupaalaa ||3||14||
lines.translation: Nanak begs for the gift of Your Name; O Lord of the world, love him, like the mother loves her child. ||3||14||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhanaasaree mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲੀਨੇ ਸੰਤ ਉਬਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har leene sa(n)t ubaar ||
lines.translation: The Lord saves His Saints.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਚਿਤਵੈ ਬੁਰਿਆਈ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਕਉ ਫਿਰਿ ਮਾਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har ke daas kee chitavai buriaaee tis hee kau phir maar ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: One who wishes misfortune upon the Lord's slaves, shall be destroyed by the Lord eventually. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਕਾ ਆਪਿ ਸਹਾਈ ਹੋਆ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਭਾਗੇ ਹਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jan kaa aap sahaaee hoaa ni(n)dak bhaage haar ||
lines.translation: He Himself is the help and support of His humble servants; He defeats the slanderers, and chases them away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਊਹਾਂ ਹੀ ਮੂਏ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਨ ਮੰਝਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: bhramat bhramat oohaa(n) hee mooe baahuR grihi na ma(n)jhaar ||1||
lines.translation: Wandering around aimlessly, they die out there; they never return to their homes again. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰਿਓ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ਸਦਾ ਅਪਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak saran pario dukh bha(n)jan gun gaavai sadaa apaar ||
lines.translation: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the Destroyer of pain; he sings the Glorious Praises of the infinite Lord forever.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਕ ਕਾ ਮੁਖੁ ਕਾਲਾ ਹੋਆ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਕੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥੨॥੧੫॥
lines.transliteration: ni(n)dak kaa mukh kaalaa hoaa deen duneeaa kai darabaar ||2||15||
lines.translation: The faces of the slanderers are blackened in the courts of this world, and the world beyond. ||2||15||

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨਾਸਿਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhanaasiree mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਬ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੁ ਚਿਤਾਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: ab har raakhanahaar chitaariaa ||
lines.translation: Now, I contemplate and meditate on the Lord, the Saviour Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਕੀਏ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਸਗਲਾ ਰੋਗੁ ਬਿਦਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: patit puneet keee khin bheetar sagalaa rog bidaariaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: He purifies sinners in an instant, and cures all diseases. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੋਸਟਿ ਭਈ ਸਾਧ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਮਿ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮਾਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: gosat bhaee saadh kai sa(n)gam kaam krodh lobh maariaa ||
lines.translation: Talking with the Holy Saints, my sexual desire, anger and greed have been eradicated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਨਾਰਾਇਨ ਸੰਗੀ ਸਗਲੇ ਤਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: simar simar pooran naaraain sa(n)gee sagale taariaa ||1||
lines.translation: Remembering, remembering the Perfect Lord in meditation, I have saved all my companions. ||1||
